text:
We open-sourced our entire marketing team.

Introducing Marketing OS for Grok Bot by Maxfusion.

A full marketing department. Each employee gets a job.

Each gets its own computer, and your logins.

They work while you sleep, no days off or sick leaves.

🖤 Head of Marketing - the mastermind
🟢 Analyst · site audits scored 0-100
🟪 SEO Lead · rankings, GEO, llms.txt
🔷 Copywriter · copy graded before you see it
⚪️ Creative Strategist · Ai ads generated with Maxfusion
🔺Media Buyer · fatigue vs dead audience, kill calls
🔵 Email Marketer · sequences written in full, schedule
🟡 Social Manager · posts that survive the feed
🟥 Launch Manager · Product Hunt, hour by hour
🟤 Pricing Strategist · tiers, offers, what to charge & why
🟩 Competitor Analyst · what they run on Meta
🟣 ASO Specialist · App Store and Play listings
🟦 Data Analyst · dashboards, A/B tests, educated answers
🔶 Editor · cuts the AI slop before anything ships

And they hand work to each other:

Competitor Analyst finds the winning angle → Creative Strategist makes 10 ads → Email Marketer launches the campaign → SEO Lead fixes the site → Analyst grades the result.

One link. Install in Grok Bot.

Comment "BOT" and I'll send it to you.
